During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, Hidden Chain forces led by [[Cantis Bralor]] '''raided''' [[Port Nowhere]] in order to capture hostages. However, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] raiders were defeated by the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Rass Ordo]] who were present onboard the station during the attack.<ref name="TOR:RtN" />
